svg.title: GraphLoom architecture
svg.desc: The CLI talks to the controller, which holds durable state, receipts and budgets. The controller talks both ways with the plugin host, which runs the graph plugin in its own process. The controller sends jobs to the runner, which dispatches them to sandboxed executors: coding-agent, command and github. Executors write to the evidence store, which the controller reads. A supervisor is attached to the controller.
